The Metric system has been changed multiple times.
The length of a meter was originally measured from a proportional distance between France and the North Pole.
It was then changed to equal the length of a bar of palladium-alloy which is also secured in a vault in France, which this itself was measured to weight 1kg.
From this they were able to determine what a unit of a Kilo-Liter was, making a cubic meter of water. (or some shit).
There might have been changes in between, however, the NEW definition of a meter is the distance light travels in 1/2998000 seconds. Which is hard to believe, but it is.
The Liter now follows this same measurement, and the kilogram is based on the density of water.

tl;dr Imperial Units never changed.
